All the classifiers were trained utilizing the BiLLM(Li et al., 2023b) and transformers（Wolf, 2019) library. The models were trained with three seeds (42,47, 49) on $4 \mathrm { x H 1 0 0 }$ until convergence. Seeds are set for torch.manual_seed(） and random.seed().
